text:
Elena Morales: Quick heads-up — we’re in the last mile for this review cycle. Handbacks + manager forms due by Friday EOD PST. If you need an exception (LOA, parental, medical), DM people-ops or reply here and we’ll route it.

Elena Morales: Please: 1) complete the manager review form, 2) fill ‘handback date’ per reportee, 3) add an alternate reviewer if you’ll be OOO. Link to form: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/review-form

Chris Nguyen: Clarifying q — do we include stretch goals in the review submission or only core commitments?

Elena Morales: Only core commitments required. Stretch goals are optional comments for context (don’t delay submitting for those).

Samir Rao: Is there a recommended format for the calibration notes? Some of my group has mixed evidence types.

Elena Morales: Use the 1-page calibration template (keeps things consistent). Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/calibration-template — TL;DR: list names, expectation baseline, 2 lines of supporting evidence, recommended band.

Priya Desai: I’ll be OOO Thu-Fri morning. What’s the proxy flow?

Elena Morales: Add an alternate reviewer in the form field named "proxy_reviewer", or email people-ops@redwood.com with the proxy and we’ll update. If a handback already scheduled, you can change the date in the CSV import (see below).

Chris Nguyen: Can I do bulk handbacks? I have 12 direct reports.

Elena Morales: Yes — there’s a CSV bulk import. CSV header: `email,reviewer,handback_date,notes`

Elena Morales: Example CSV snippet:
```
email,reviewer,handback_date,notes
alice@redwood.com,chris@redwood.com,2025-06-12,"FY24 core deliverables, promotion discussion"
bob@redwood.com,chris@redwood.com,2025-06-12,"needs follow-up on goal clarity"
```

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Review form deadline in 72 hours for 23 people in your queue. Please complete or mark an alternate reviewer. :alarm_clock:

Samir Rao: Small ask — can we limit calibration groups to 8-10 names max? Past cycles got too long.

Elena Morales: Good point. Aim for ~8 per calibration session. If you need a split, add notes in the template and we’ll schedule multiple slots.

Priya Desai: Thanks — will add proxy and upload CSV tonight.

Elena Morales: Thanks all — ping me or people-ops@redwood.com for exceptions. We’ll post final schedule for calibration blocks by EOD tomorrow. :wave:
